issues.body: The prior major finding is unchanged. Immediately after the revised ignore-list paragraph, `The advisories-gate gap (GX-1 — know this)` still states that `cargo deny check advisories` is `continue-on-error (non-gating)`. That directly contradicts `.github/workflows/supply-chain.yml`, AGENTS.md, and the compliance evidence changed here, which all describe the check as fail-closed and gating after the CVSS-v4 blocker was resolved. This is operational guidance for agents, so the stale section can still cause incorrect security and audit conclusions.
issues.fix_hint: Replace or remove the obsolete GX-1 gap section in this PR. State that the CVSS-v4 parsing blocker tracked by sq-q8de is resolved, the PR-time `cargo deny check advisories` step is gating with no `continue-on-error`, and the daily dependency monitor is defense in depth.
issues.title: Supply-chain skill still says the advisory check is non-gating

verdict.summary: Round 2 is improving: the prior minor wording inconsistency in compliance/sbom/evidence.md was fixed, but the prior major contradiction remains. The updated supply-chain skill still immediately follows its revised ignore-list guidance with an obsolete GX-1 section claiming the advisory check is continue-on-error and non-gating, while the workflow and other documentation in this same diff say it is fail-closed and gating. Because this is operational agent guidance, the contradiction remains release-blocking.
